browser_test_scope: Actual Chromium ran exact compiled widget modules and CSS. Managed browser blocked localhost navigation. HTTP serving and Uvicorn were exercised separately; this is not React/PaaS or complete accessibility certification.
what_runs_now: The shipped standalone Lab starts with python3 dev lab and needs no npm, external assets, database or identity.
architecture: Strict-TypeScript DOM/SVG widget implementation with controlled React adapter. Separate React/FastAPI host remains in the repository; its dependency installation/build is not certified.
